name: ehr-quality-governance
description: Prepare normalized JSON quality-governance packets for EHR clinical review workflows. This skill covers EHR duplicate-chart merge readiness, referral coordination packets, care transition summaries, service-request quality validation, and referral audit batch processing. Use this skill whenever the user mentions EHR, electronic health records, duplicate patient merge, referral audit, clinical quality governance, care transitions, SBAR coverage, ICD-10 validation, HIM merge packets, orthopedic/cardiology/pulmonary referral coordination, or any structured clinical data reconciliation against a REST EHR API. Use it even when the user only hints at "duplicate chart review," "referral batch," "care transition packet," "merge readiness," or "quality-governance."
